property_summary: After calling setOwner with a new address, the reference updates owner to that address, while the buggy version keeps owner unchanged. The test sets owner to address(0x123) via setOwner and asserts that owner returns address(0x123).
change_summary: Replace the assignment with a no-op (self-assignment) to owner.
mutated_unit_code: function setOwner(address _owner) public onlyOwner returns (bool success) { owner = owner; return true; }
